name: label-tag
title: Label tag
description: A hang tag: cut card with clipped corners (or an arched top, or a luggage tag's clipped end), a hole with a reinforcing patch and a brass eyelet, and a loop of twine. The whole silhouette is one drawn sheet, so the string and the eyelet turn and cast their shadow with the card. As a link or a button it swings on its eyelet.

a11y: A tag is a `div`: put text in it. As a link or button (`asChild`) it keeps its native role, focus and keyboard behavior; the drawing is aria-hidden decoration and the swing is a hover-only, reduced-motion-aware nicety (none in calm density).

Information carried by the twine color or the eyelet must also be in text. Ink on kraft, paper and the sticky stocks is at least 9:1; the price is a red darkened with ink and reads at least 4.9:1 on all of them.
The tilt is zero in calm density; Windows high contrast replaces the drawing with a real outline around the box (the string is not shown).
